imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The foam-roller guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap showed 26 discovered URLs and zero indexed URLs in the report snapshot.
searchConsole.decision: The queryless homepage sample is too small to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one citation-worthy authority expansion and two unrelated evergreen explorations while strengthening hubs, reciprocal links and sitemap discovery.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or another variation on an existing topic.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the foam-roller guide. The lost-wallet and flannel-shirt guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy lost-wallet and identity-recovery control file that separates payment-card containment, identity-risk decisions, government-document replacement, evidence retention and case closure.
authority.cluster: Consumer recovery and personal-record authority, with reciprocal paths from wallet selection, credit freezes, identity-theft recovery and digital-account recovery; the other pages strengthen recovery-tool and practical-shirt clusters.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for FTC consumer education and the U.S. Department of State passport-information team; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions in Life, Fitness and Style: how to recover from a lost wallet, how to choose and use a foam roller conservatively, and how to buy a flannel shirt by fit and label. Only the equipment guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
